notes.title: Universe Exploration patch soon
notes.content: [p]Probably the largest patch since the graphics overhaul is reaching its testing phase soon so I just wanted to post here to let people know progress is still happening. [/p][p]Brand new universe exploration UI with a much more modern feel should make the game feel more approachable to new players,  there will also be fuel cost for travel as well as randomly generated events while traveling that could be anything from traveling merchants to combat encounters in your vessel and much more.  Solar systems will accurately depict what types of planets are in them from the universe map while planets actively rotate around different types of suns (some of which have effects on the levels in the solar system).  The player can now also see what missions are available in what systems and make travel choices based on that, though the missions also have time limits before resetting as well meaning you have to choose which rewards you really want.  [/p][p]Overall I'm really happy with the progress on this and I do feel this is the patch that is making the game start to feel like a full game as I originally intended it.  I'm hoping to release by the end of August but it could easily drag into September. [/p][p]The patch after this one will largely focus on better level generation and increased multiplayer stability and quality of life, the penciled in goal for that patch is mid December but that is still a bit up in the air.[/p][p]As always thanks for playing![/p]

The player can now also see what missions are available in what systems and make travel choices based on that, though the missions also have time limits before resetting as well meaning you have to choose which rewards you really want

notes.title: Ophioc Ship Patch
notes.content:
This patch is primarily adding a tile set called Ophioc Ship, it houses a few new enemies and a few old ones from the Ophioc faction.  There are some new hidden mechanics on the level as well that I won't list here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/f2594fd8bfecf9f833db9526c165ef28cadcd269.png[/img]

Here is a screenshot of the new level alongside a few of the new enemies.  

On another note, this patch took a lot longer than I expected it to.  I am also starting a new job next week which I'm very excited for but will most likely reduce the time I have to spend working on Dead Metal.  But don't worry I'm hardly done working, just trying to set low expectations for the timing of the next patch.  

Speaking of the next patch, finally finally finally getting the new wave defense mode into the game.  It would have made it into this patch but I keep finding bugs with it.  I think it would be best to focus on it for its own patch as opposed to releasing it alongside the tile set.  I am hoping to have that patch out by the end of April as the content is mostly done and its mainly bugfixes remaining.  

Post that is going to be some of the largest patches the game will see and there will be months between them.  These patches are aiming for a few things, the first of which is making the gameplay loop feel cleaner and more eventful.  I will be reducing the size of the explorable galaxy while increasing the variety of things that can spawn within it which should cause players to find cool parts of the universe way faster.   I've loosely scheduled this patch for August as it will be completely redoing a lot of random universe generation and adding a ton of random events for players to encounter both in levels and while using the new space travel system... also there will be a new space travel system.  

The next major patch I'm aiming for late November and it will be the revamped level generation patch.  Making more interesting levels that make some contextual sense as to what they are will be the goal here.  So if you raid a space pirate ship that ship will reasonably have a bridge, an engine room, cafeteria, ect ect.  I  also want missions to reflect this new more intelligent level design, missions to steal data for the server room of a building, or sabotage various parts of a massive ship.  A lot of the ideas for this patch are not concrete but I do know that the current level generation isn't meeting what I want for the game.

That's all for now, as always thanks for playing!

notes.title: Graphics Update Finally Arrived!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, its finally here.  After a solid 4 months of work basically every single piece of art has been redone and it looks a lot better. A lot of bugs have been fixed as well but I was so focused on art that I don't have a great change log for that. Instead I will just post some examples of the new art below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/b13937ff46e3cbaefe207e517bb86e31ca71925e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/9cbd8480f0831ec1d26b8778b7dcc148d208197a.png[/img]

As you can see these are some pretty huge upgrades from the prior art and the steam page has been adjusted to show it off as well.  I will be paying very close attention for any bugs caused by this patch as a lot of assets were deleted and replaced, I have successfully played through the game with all bosses cleared once but I intend to do it again to make sure there wasn't anything huge missed.  

Work will begin almost immediately on a new tileset and a wave defense mission type, the next patch will most likely be in November sometime including all of the above plus a boss or two.  

As always thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update on graphics improvement patch
notes.content:
Hello, I know I said there would be an intermediate patch with about half the new graphics but the new graphics combined with the old ones look.... silly.  So I'm burning through all of it and hoping to be done by August 20th.  Progress is still going well and part of the delay is coming in the form of scope creep, for instance now we have shadows rendered under most units and objects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/da2abe357d14837a6a5c6471d4db77853bf7e018.png[/img]

This is a WIP preview of the new art with shadows included, right now all the player character art is done as well as half the tile sets and 4/5 of the units. While it might be a little later than Aug 20th this will be the largest patch yet in terms of effort put in. After that its back to content content content as Im going to be adding a new mission type as well as another tile set before the end of the year.  A few bosses should be making their way in as well. 

That's it for now, just letting it be known work is still continuing!

notes.title: Multiplayer Stability Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43191354/3656abfdd909a280b0b141ef5655a1bf8c97a5b8.png[/img]

As you may or not have noticed there have been a multitude of small patches going out this month and that will continue until the new year when I go back to working on new features.  These patches are improving the multiplayer experience in terms of bug fixes and general stability. 

---PATCH NOTES---
-Music now correctly plays on a certain boss
-Creating a new dead metal suit in MP will no longer overwrite money
-Clients should no longer sometimes get 2 level ups instead of 1
-Correct type of loot box (art not contents, the contents were always fine) will show on each players screen in MP now
-2x2 Mob movement is now correctly synced across the board in MP
-Psystaff mindbruise effect now correctly updates health bar on other players screens when it damages something
-Energy knife stab no longer leaves an incorrect poison effect on enemies on other players screens
-Footsteps should now correctly be silenced by turning off your sound

There will probably be one or two more similar patches before the end of the year, then to start off the new year I'm looking to add in some more character customization options and some new abilities.  After that ice planets will be added to world gen with a unique type of wave defense mission you can run to gather more ore for upgrades.  (I'm aware that gathering ore in the current state is tedious) 

That's all for now, as always thanks for playing!

notes.title: MP Usability Update 1
notes.content:
The last patch fixed a lot of issues with the normal game UI (outside of levels) and this patch is mainly another UI focused one.  The multiplayer interface to get into a lobby can be confusing and buggy, this patch as well as another one coming this weekend are seeking to fix that.  

-You will now be prompted upon launching the game to create a user name for multiplayer, this username will appear when you join a match lobby now so you can see who is in your lobby and in which slot. 

-You can change above mentioned username from the multiplayer screen, you will find a new button on the bottom right of that screen.

-Fixed bug caused when the AI Boss was killed
-Fixed issue with game loading other saves bots in strange conditions
-Fixed issue causing the new UI screen to go blank when no abilities are selected on your bots
-Fixed issue with multiplayer just giving you the tutorial level on space pirate levels over and over

Thats it for now, more multiplayer UI stuff coming this weekend as well as a good amount of multiplayer gameplay bug fixes.  

Thanks for playing!
